test_title: PYST 15: RRB Group D - GS (Held On: 03 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: An object is said to be in uniform motion if:

options.text: it covers equal distances in unequal time intervals
it covers equal distances in equal time intervals
it covers unequal distances in unequal time intervals
it covers unequal distances in equal time intervals

solution:
The correct answer is __**it covers equal distances in equal time intervals**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Uniform motion** is defined as the motion of an object in which it covers **equal distances in equal intervals of time**, irrespective of the duration of the interval.
 
• An object exhibiting uniform motion has a **constant speed** because the distance covered per unit of time remains unchanged.
 
• This motion occurs along a **straight path**, as the direction of motion does not change over time.
 
• If an object is moving with uniform motion, its velocity-time graph will be a **straight horizontal line**, indicating that velocity remains constant.
 
• Examples of uniform motion include **light traveling in a vacuum** or a car moving at a constant speed on a straight road.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Non-uniform motion:**

 
 
• In non-uniform motion, an object covers **unequal distances** in **equal intervals of time** or vice versa.
 
• The speed of the object changes with time, and the motion may involve acceleration or deceleration.
 
• Examples include a car slowing down or speeding up while traveling through traffic.
 
 
 
• **Speed:**
 
 
• Speed is the **rate at which an object covers distance**. It is a scalar quantity and is calculated as: Speed = Distance / Time.
 
• Uniform motion implies a **constant speed** over time.
 
 
 
• **Velocity:**
 
 
• Velocity is the **speed of an object in a particular direction**. It is a vector quantity.
 
• Uniform motion also implies constant velocity if the direction of motion is unchanged.
 
 
 
• **Graphical Representation:**
 
 
• For uniform motion, the **distance-time graph** is a straight line with a constant slope.
 
• The slope of the distance-time graph represents the speed of the object.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Option 1:** "It covers equal distances in unequal time intervals" is incorrect because this describes non-uniform motion where speed varies over time.
 
• **Option 2:** "It covers equal distances in equal time intervals" is correct as it accurately defines uniform motion.
 
• **Option 3:** "It covers unequal distances in unequal time intervals" is incorrect because this also describes non-uniform motion.
 
• **Option 4:** "It covers unequal distances in equal time intervals" is incorrect as it indicates variable speed, which is a characteristic of non-uniform motion.
